intent: A short note that floats in after an action, like Saved successfully, and goes away on its own after a few seconds, with an optional Undo.
useWhen: Confirming an action people just took: saved, sent, deleted
Offering a quick Undo right after a change
doNotUseWhen: Errors people must fix or read later — use Alert on the page
Long forms or multi-step work — use Modal

open.note: Shows the toast. Set it when the action happens.

onClose.note: () => void. Time up, Dismiss, or after the action.

title.note: The bold line, like Saved successfully.

status.note: Colors the icon and the countdown bar. Card stays surface-card. info an i, success a check, warning a triangle, danger an alert mark.

actionLabel.note: One action under the text, like Undo.

onAction.note: () => void. Runs when the action is picked; the toast then closes. Required in practice when actionLabel is set.

duration.note: How long it stays, in ms, while the bar counts down. Default 5000 for every status. null keeps it until closed, with no bar.

requirements: Every open Toast portals into one shared stack at the bottom right. Create the stack if missing (role=status, aria-live=polite). Newest at the bottom. No Toaster.
info, success, and warning use role=status with aria-live=polite. danger uses role=alert (assertive).
The countdown pauses while the pointer is over the toast or focus is inside it.
Hover or focus pauses the timer so people can reach Dismiss or the action.
Dismiss is a kit Button named Dismiss. The icon and the bar are decorative.
The action is at least 24px tall (WCAG 2.5.8).
It fades in unless the person prefers reduced motion.

doNot: Do not invent ToastTitle, ToastDescription, ToastAction, ToastViewport, or Toaster. Render Toast.
Do not use Alert for toast feedback — Alert stays on the page
Do not pass action as a ReactNode slot — use actionLabel
Do not put more than one action in a toast
Do not use variant=primary inside the toast
Do not use status=default, size, onOpenChange, density, HelpPopover, or Icon
Do not make duration shorter than people need to read it and reach the action
Do not use glass, color-mix, or backdrop-blur
snippet:
<Toast
  open={saved}
  onClose={() => setSaved(false)}
  title="Saved successfully"
  description="Your changes have been saved."
  actionLabel="Undo"
  onAction={undo}
/>
